page_title: VIL 3-1 ALA | Villarreal v Alaves 10/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Miguel Ortiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' A rebound falls to Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
90' Villarreal are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.

85' 3 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Toni Martinez (Alaves) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 3:1.
82' Substitution. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alfonso Pedraza walks off.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carles Alena leaves the pitch and Aitor Manas (Alaves) comes on.
80' Here is a change. Jon Guridi is going off and Eduardo Coudet gives the last tactical orders to Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
79' The attendance for today's match is 17011.
77' Substitution. Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) has come on for Alberto Moleiro.
75' 3 - 0 Goal! Alberto Moleiro gets to the ball, slips Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 3:0.
74' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
73' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the left post.
69' Carles Alena (Alaves) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
68' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) replacing Tajon Buchanan.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dani Parejo departs the field of play to be replaced by Thomas Partey (Villarreal).
66' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

66' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Villarreal force a corner. They send men into the box.
63' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
61' Alaves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
59' Eduardo Coudet prepares a substitution. Pablo Ibanez is replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yusi (Alaves) replaces Jonny Otto.

55' 2 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Antonio Sivera. 2:0.
53' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
49' 1 - 0 Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) gets to a rebound just outside the penalty area and unleashes a fabulous effort that goes in off the inside of the right post.

48' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marcelino gives a chance to Gerard Moreno and Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Jonny Otto (Alaves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
45' Jonny Otto (Alaves) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
44' Carles Alena (Alaves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
43' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) takes a short free kick.
42' It looks like Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) saw red with that tackle. Miguel Ortiz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
41' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

37' The most active player in today's match is definitely Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
32' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
31' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
29' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
29' Alaves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Fouls committed – 3:7.
25' Wonderful movement by Villarreal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
23' Luiz Junior steps in and intercepts a long pass from Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
20' Victor Parada (Alaves) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
18' An attempted cross from Victor Parada (Alaves) is cleared.
17' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Alaves are awarded a corner kick.

17' Alaves slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
14' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Luiz Junior comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
12' Jon Guridi (Alaves) trips an opposition player and Miguel Ortiz signals a foul.
10' The game has begun to heat up. Carles Alena (Alaves) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
8' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) plays a through ball but overhits it.
5' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Villarreal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' Toni Martinez (Alaves) fires a powerful volley towards goal, but his shot lacks accuracy and is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Miguel Ortiz was nominated as the referee for this game.
